protocol.title: Delayed L3 slot unfreezing interaction

training.delayed_rule: read/fusion active from step 1; slot queries open after step 300 or 600; all other L2/L3 Memory groups remain frozen

protocol.primary_test: delayed slot opening improves joint-from-start and approaches read-only recovery
protocol.stop_rule: no extra delays, arms, thresholds, seeds, or steps

diagnosis.interpretation_scope: Four frozen outcome-stratified endpoints; not a prevalence estimate.
diagnosis.registered_stop_boundary: Report the fixed parameter-group intervention. Do not add groups, layers, seeds, steps, or post-hoc gates.
